description: A run's evidence becomes the session loop's gate only when no gate (or the same gate) is recorded. Otherwise the gate and stage are kept, the run is recorded as last_run, and the command says so. `hexa loop gate` alone replaces the gate.

specs.description: A loop with no gate picks up the run's evidence and stage
specs.given: a session entry with no `gate` key and stage `plan`
specs.when: a run calls record_run_gate with evidence `cargo test -p strata-bench` and stage `build`
specs.then: the entry's gate is `cargo test -p strata-bench` and its stage is `build`

specs.description: Both null and empty string count as no gate
specs.given: one session entry whose gate is null and another whose gate is the empty string ""
specs.when: a run records evidence `make check` with stage `build` against each entry
specs.then: each entry's gate becomes `make check` and its stage becomes `build`

specs.description: With the same gate recorded, the stage moves
specs.given: a session entry with gate `cargo test -p strata-bench` and stage `build`
specs.when: a run records evidence `cargo test -p strata-bench` with stage `harden`
specs.then: the gate is still `cargo test -p strata-bench` and the stage is `harden`

specs.description: A whitespace-only or otherwise non-empty gate is not treated as none
specs.when: a run records evidence `cargo test -p strata-server`
specs.then: the gate is not overwritten. A non-empty gate does not count as none.

specs.description: The gate is written exactly when it was none or equal
specs.given: any recorded gate G (absent, null, "", or any non-empty string) and any non-empty run evidence E with stage T
specs.then: the resulting gate is E and the stage is T exactly when G is none or G == E. In every other case the gate stays G and the stage is unchanged.

specs.description: A different gate is kept and the run goes to last_run (the strata incident)
specs.given: a session entry with gate `scripts/spike-gate.sh` and stage `build`
specs.when: a `hexa do` run records evidence `/tmp/s28-gate.sh && cargo test -p strata-server` with stage `done`
specs.then: the gate is `scripts/spike-gate.sh`, the stage is `build`, and last_run is {gate: `/tmp/s28-gate.sh && cargo test -p strata-server`, stage: `done`, at: <time of the run>}

specs.description: A side run must not move the loop's stage
specs.given: a session entry with gate `A` and stage `build`
specs.when: a run records evidence `B` with stage `done`
specs.then: the stage is not `done`, and a later `hexa loop stage done` runs `A`, not `B`

specs.description: A run never writes last_run into another session's entry
specs.when: a run in S1 records evidence `B`
specs.then: S1 gains last_run with gate `B`, and S2's gate, stage and last_run are unchanged

specs.description: On a mismatch only last_run changes
specs.given: any entry with non-empty gate G, stage T0 and any other fields, and any run evidence E != G with stage T
specs.then: gate == G, stage == T0, last_run == {gate: E, stage: T, at: <run time>}, and every other field is unchanged

specs.description: Keeping the gate prints one line
specs.when: note_run_gate is called with evidence `cargo test -p strata-server`
specs.then: exactly one line is printed. It names `scripts/spike-gate.sh` as the kept gate and says the run's evidence was recorded as last_run.

specs.description: No 'kept' line when nothing was kept
specs.given: a session entry with no gate, and another with the same gate as the run
specs.then: no line about a kept gate or last_run is printed

specs.description: The line is printed exactly when the gate was kept
specs.given: any recorded gate G and any run evidence E
specs.then: the kept-gate line, naming G, is printed exactly once when G is non-empty and G != E, and is never printed otherwise

specs.description: The operator command still replaces the gate
specs.when: the operator runs `hexa loop gate 'cargo test -p strata-server'`

specs.description: `hexa loop gate` does not go through the keep rule
specs.given: a session entry with a different, non-empty gate
specs.then: the gate is not kept, no last_run is written, and no kept-gate line is printed

specs.given: any recorded gate G (including none) and any command X

specs.description: harden writes fast_gate only when the gate was written
specs.given: one entry with no gate and another with gate `A`
specs.when: `hexa harden` records evidence `B` with a fast_gate `F` against each entry
specs.then: the entry with no gate gets gate `B` and fast_gate `F`. The entry with gate `A` keeps gate `A`, its fast_gate is not set to `F`, and its last_run records `B`.

specs.description: do, build and harden all apply the rule
specs.given: a session entry with gate `A` and stage `build`
specs.when: each of `hexa do`, `hexa build` and `hexa harden` runs once with evidence `B`
specs.then: after each run the gate is `A` and the stage is `build`, and the kept-gate line is printed each time

specs.description: No caller writes gate through update_loop
specs.given: the source files hexa-cli/src/commands/direct.rs and hexa-cli/src/commands/build.rs, and the harden command source
specs.when: they are searched for update_loop calls
specs.then: no update_loop call writes a `"gate"` key

specs.description: Every run-path gate write goes through record_run_gate
specs.given: any of `hexa do`, `hexa build` or `hexa harden`, and any recorded entry state
specs.then: the resulting gate, stage, fast_gate and last_run equal what record_run_gate would produce for that entry, evidence and stage
